# Original material and attribution

DND's game design and BASIC source originated with **Daniel M. Lawrence**, with subsequent ports and contributions credited in the [source repository](https://github.com/monadicus/dnd). The DOS version was developed by **Bill Knight / R O Software**. The DOS executable identifies copyright 1984, 1986 R O Software; its archive includes additional documentation and release notes. The five dungeon files under `assets/dungeons/` are unmodified original game data downloaded from RGB Classic Games for this local recreation.

The original material is not claimed as newly authored Rust code and has not been relicensed. The DOS distribution's notice includes limitations on redistribution, including distribution with another product and distribution in modified form. Public availability and the word "shareware" do not constitute an open-source license. This local project is marked `publish = false`; no package or game has been published. Any future public release should resolve permission for the original game data and source-derived material or arrange for users to supply their own original data.

The locally retained `reference/` directory includes unmodified source and original DOS documents for inspection and is ignored by version control. Its provenance is recorded in `docs/REVERSE_ENGINEERING.md`. The project does not bundle the executable into the Rust program.

Rust dependencies retain their respective licenses as declared in their packages and recorded in `Cargo.lock`.
